approval.title: {{app}} requests “{{permission}}”
approval.subtitle: This grants the named capability to this app for your current Nimi account.
approval.combinedSubtitle: Review and decide each permission separately. A decision for one item does not decide the others.

intent.agentsInteract: Interact with all Agents in your account

intentDescription.agentsInteract: Open conversations, send turns, and receive conversation updates for current and future Agents.
intentDescription.agentsConfigure: Read and change model, behavior, autonomy, voice reference, and appearance settings.
intentDescription.aiTextGenerate: Generate reviewable text candidates through the Runtime-managed local model. The app cannot choose a provider, model, credential, tool, or media input.
intentDescription.memoryRead: Read memory content for current and future Agents.
intentDescription.agentsVoice: Use voice and transcription execution for current and future Agents.
intentDescription.agentsDelegate: Ask current and future Agents to perform delegated actions.

dependency.interactRequired: Requires an effective Interact with Agents grant for this account.
dependency.interactMissing: Approve Interact with Agents first. Until that grant is effective, this item cannot be approved.
dependency.interactIneffective: This grant is currently ineffective because Interact with Agents is not granted for this account.

scope.title: This app and your current account
scope.description: Each grant is bound to this app and account. Agent permissions include current and future Agents; AI text generation does not expose model or provider credentials.

state.error: Permission management is unavailable. Try again.
state.ambiguousOwner: Permission ownership is ambiguous for this app.
state.unsafeRevoke: This permission cannot be safely revoked.

settings.title: App permissions
settings.description: Manage each granted app capability independently.
settings.noCurrentAgents: No Agents exist in this account yet; future Agents are included automatically.
settings.noPermissions: This app has no permission records.
